verdicts.reason: A keeps the original's tight headline/subcopy/CTA stack and type hierarchy. But it is still a plain vertical copy on the square canvas: the book cover is small, the whole column is narrow with wide empty sides, and there is a large dead gap between the cover and the headline. B has the same empty-sides problem and also breaks the grouping: the shrunken one-line headline floats about 80px above its subcopy, and the smaller text, CTA and footer make it more washed-out and weaker in hierarchy.
